experiment.title: SCE 1.8: Encrypted CodeBuild Artifact Control
experiment.description: Preventive probe validating that S3 encryption enforcement and bucket policies block credential exfiltration from malicious CodeBuild projects. Targets MITRE ATT&CK T1552.005 (Unsecured Credentials) through enforced artifact encryption.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: CodeBuild artifacts are encrypted at rest and unencrypted credential exfiltration is blocked
